requests.title: CIM microsecond timestamps compared to unrounded 100ns FILETIME reject valid process identities
requests.explanation: CIM DATETIME supports six fractional decimal digits (microseconds); converting it to FILETIME does not restore the missing sub-microsecond digit. GetProcessTimes and the owned helper retain 100ns integers. The strict comparisons for child and Python parent reject a valid creation timestamp when it is not divisible by ten.
requests.requested_change: Preserve both original timestamps and their precision; compare a documented common microsecond representation, or collect an independent exact kernel creation time. Keep actual PID/parent-chain checks, distinguish resolution from 100ns observation, and add non-divisible-by-ten and true different-creation controls.

primary_documentation.supports: CIM fractional field has six microsecond digits
